title: Data gap (filed 2026-11-01): no keyless option-chain or IV-surface history for a priced straddle test of forecast-vs-implied vol; TLT has no keyless IV series
note: FOUND 2026-11-01 (lane RESEARCH-EDGE, unit RQ-20261101-58e4-07, PR #22117). Reachable keyless: CBOE vol INDICES on FRED (VIX, VXN, RVX, GVZ, OVX, VXSLV) = 30-day IV for SPY QQQ IWM GLD USO SLV. Done when the operator picks (a), (b) or drops it.
